{{Vanilla|Glass Bottle}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''glass bottle''' is a container for liquids. It is far cheaper to make in Matcha Flavoured than in vanilla ''Minecraft'', because the pack uses bottles in many recipes: every preserve and pickle in the [[Food|food system]], [[benzene]], [[Milk Bottle|milk bottles]] and [[oil]]. Filled with water it becomes a '''[[#Water bottle|water bottle]]''', which stacks to 64 and is used in crafting as a source of water.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
* Three [[glass]] in a V shape make 9 bottles, three times the vanilla output.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/glass_bottle.json}}</ref>
* A single glass block makes 3 bottles on its own.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/glass_bottle_alternate.json}}</ref>
Both give 3 bottles per glass. The vanilla recipe is removed. Picking up glass unlocks the V-shaped recipe.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/glass.json}}</ref>

=== Returned from crafting ===
Many recipes that use up a bottled ingredient give the empty bottle back to the player. This covers the water bottle in flower cloning, making [[mud]], clay from mud, concrete from concrete powder, aging copper, [[phosphor]] and green [[Dyes|dye]], and the [[benzene]] in [[Stabilized Estus|stabilized estus]]. The bottle is added to the inventory by a function when the recipe is crafted, not left in the crafting grid.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/advancement_glass_bottle_from_crafting.mcfunction}}</ref> The green curry, paneer curry and pumpkin curry [[stock]]s return both of their bottles (oil and milk bottle).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/two_glass_bottles_from_crafting.json}}</ref> Eating a jar of [[Glow Berry Jam|glow berry jam]] also leaves a bottle.

In 1.12.2-beta, the advancement names most food recipes and the [[Hell-Bound Book|hell-bound book]] by their old recipe IDs, so those crafts use up the bottle: [[Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|apple cinnamon oatmeal]], [[Buñuelo|buñuelos]], [[cake]], [[Chicken Nugget|chicken nuggets]], [[Chorus Mochi|chorus mochi]], [[dough]] from a water bottle, [[Fish and Chips|fish and chips]], [[gimmari]], [[Glow Berry Crumble|glow berry crumble]], the hell-bound book, [[Ice Cream|ice cream]], [[latke]]s, [[lumpia]], [[pupusa]]s, [[seitan]], [[Warped Stroganoff|warped stroganoff]], and curry and ramen stock. The <code>main</code> branch fixes the IDs, so these return the bottle in the next version. [[Cheese]] and the other stroganoffs don't return it on either.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref> See [[Known bugs]].

== Water bottle ==
{{Infobox auto|Potion|title=Water Bottle}}
A '''water bottle''' is a glass bottle filled from a water source, as in vanilla. The pack changes it in two ways:
* '''It stacks to 64.''' When a player who is not in Creative mode picks up or fills a water bottle, the pack swaps it for an identical water bottle that stacks to 64.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/water_bottle/process_water_bottle.mcfunction}}</ref> The check does not run in Creative mode, where the game refills items and the swap could duplicate bottles. In 1.12.2-beta the check only tests whether ''some'' player is not in Creative mode, so in multiplayer a Creative player's bottles are still swapped while anyone else is in another mode.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/water_bottle/check_if_water_bottle_should_be_processed.mcfunction}}</ref>
* '''It is a crafting ingredient.''' Many of the pack's recipes use a water bottle as their water. The recipe book shows these ingredients as a plain, contentless potion, which vanilla names "Uncraftable Potion"; the pack renames it "Water Bottle" so the recipes read correctly.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> The recipes accept any potion in that slot.

Recipes that use a water bottle include:
{| class="wikitable"
! Recipe !! Result
|-
| Water bottle + 8 [[dirt]] || 8 [[mud]]
|-
| Water bottle + 8 mud || 4 clay
|-
| Water bottle + 8 concrete powder || 8 concrete
|-
| Water bottle + a copper block (or copper item) || the next oxidation stage
|-
| Water bottle + flower + bone meal || 4 of that flower (see [[Hyacinth#Cloning]])
|-
| Water bottle + [[Sulfur Chunk|sulfur chunk]] + 4 [[Glow Lichen|glow lichen]] || 8 [[phosphor]]
|-
| Water bottle + raw copper + sulfur chunk || 2 green dye
|}
Water bottles can also be caught while [[fishing]]; the [[Angler's Almanac]] gives the chance as 9% of junk catches.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/anglers_almanac/junk/water_bottle.json}}</ref>
